title: Sing Woo Dan

page_data.en:
No. 757 QN1
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 13th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

Sir,
Between 1 and 4 p.m. on the 14th inst a memorial service will be held in the Sing Woo Dan 新舞台 theatre City in honour of the late General Tsai Ao 蔡鍔。 All the prominent business men and gentry will attend.
It is reported that about 4 p.m. on the 11th inst two men representing themselves as being sent by the Vice President to inspect the Military Camp at Loongwha called on General Yang one of them presenting a card bearing the name of Colonel Woo Kwaung Yoh 何光裕 General Yang gave them permission to look over the place and they left to do so leaving a small black bag behind. As they did not return the bag was opened and found to contain two bombs and a letter abusing General Yang for his hostile attitude towards the rebels and threatening to kill him.
The two delegates from Tientsin have again interviewed representatives of the Chamber of Commerce and the Press Association pressing them to take more active steps against the French on account of the Tientsin incident.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLauclan Strong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
编号 757 QN1
上海工部局。
1916年12月13日

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

先生：

本月14日下午1时至4时，将在城内新舞台戏院举行追悼会，以纪念已故的蔡锷将军。所有知名商绅均将出席。

据报，本月11日下午4时许，两名男子自称受副总统派遣，前来视察龙华军营，拜访了杨将军。其中一人出示了一张写有何光裕上校名字的名片。杨将军准许他们参观该地，二人随即前往查看，留下一个小黑包。因二人未归，该包被打开，发现内有两枚炸弹及一封信件，信中辱骂杨将军对叛军持敌对态度，并威胁要杀害他。

来自天津的两名代表再次会见了商会和报业公会的代表，敦促他们因天津事件而对法国人采取更积极的行动。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克劳克兰·斯特朗 (McLauclan Strong)
总探长

警察总监
